signature: SUBROUTINE ZLAG2C( M, N, A, LDA, SA, LDSA, INFO )

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of lines of the matrix A. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the M-by-N coefficient matrix A.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: SA
params.reference: On exit, if `INFO=0`, the M-by-N coefficient matrix `SA`; if $\mathrm{INFO}>0$, the content of `SA` is unspecified.

params.name: ldsa
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `SA`. $\mathrm{LDSA} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit.
-   `= 1`: an entry of the matrix A is greater than the SINGLE PRECISION overflow threshold, in this case, the content of `SA` in exit is unspecified.
